items.prompt: Why is a successful in-memory SQL rollback test insufficient to sign off a durable trading journal?
items.modelAnswer: It does not test file persistence,process/OS crash,power loss,journal/synchronous settings,storage flush behavior,backup/restore or concurrent writers. Need source/version/cursor consistency,reopen/crash/fault tests and reconciled remote effects separately. Controlled exception rollback proves only its tested local transaction boundary.
